api.preparationAttachment: boolean always present, true only for a visible existing locate attachment anchor in a verified preparation table row
api.relatedLabel: safe unique fixed same-row form document title for true preparationAttachment; source label/action remain unchanged
api.preparationAttachmentNodes: number[] always present, empty when false; at most48 weak node identities serialized by existing includeSupplemental sourceSnapshot
api.earlyReturns: The existing detached/parentless supplemental return includes both fields.

evidence: HTML table with one visible unmerged header row and matching unmerged body cells; unique standard title and attachment columns in any order
Visible bounded fixed preparation caption, or nearest preceding semantic heading within the same local region; an explicit incompatible caption does not borrow an outer heading
Unique fixed same-row claim/application/declaration/consent/authorization form title; bounded balanced parenthetical modifiers and compound fixed title allowed
Attachment is a sourceAction locate anchor with a fixed HWP/HWPX/DOC/DOCX/PDF/ZIP filename/operation marker; no query values interpreted
Form-wrapper allowance is exclusive to this new anchor relationship; title default-submit button is read only as fixed label dependency and is never flagged or activated
exclusions: Hidden title/heading/header and hidden nested title text
Nested tables, duplicate title/attachment columns, merged cells, multiple header rows
Multiple title controls or distinct extra title-cell subject
Software/report/news/archive subject rows without actual form-document title/preparation purpose
Ordinary navigate anchor and download button are not new preparationAttachment sources
implementation.cache: One caller-supplied SupplementalCache caches table parsing and row attachments inside a synchronous analysis/currentness batch. No interpreted metadata is retained between batches. A separate WeakMap<Element,number> retains identity only and does not strongly retain DOM nodes.
implementation.currentness: Bounded identities include source anchor, title and nested title elements, title/attachment cells and row, table header and nested label elements, caption/heading and nested label elements, tbody/thead/table/form/local ancestor containers. Same-text replacement changes tokens while relatedLabel and locate action may stay equal.
implementation.privacy: Uses fixed safe names, attributes, semantic structure and node identities. Does not read input.value, checked, selected option state, textContent/innerText of private editors, hidden body prose, document title, evaluation IDs or opaque query values.
limits: New preparation relation supports HTML tables only, not arbitrary role=grid tables. Existing materialRow behavior remains unchanged.
Bounds:2-12 columns, at most8 attachment anchors, fixed-name descendant count<=16, ancestor paths<=10, identity tokens<=48. Ineligible or excessive structures stay unresolved.
Semantic helper is not the shared danger-policy gate; root classifier must continue dangerous URL/script/label/relatedLabel checks before consuming the flag.

baseline.note: Positive relationship and unchanged-action/currentness gaps failed before any analyzer implementation.

intermediate.note: Initial implementation had a balanced-parenthesis closing-branch defect; corrected without broadening the grammar.

relatedFocused.scope: Passed before the final nested fixed-label dependency extension; not asserted to be a final-source full-suite run.

nestedIdentityBaseline.note: Same-text nested column-label span replacement remained current=true; added nested header/caption dependencies.

finalFocused.scope: Final source, includes fixed-name nested node replacement, same-batch reuse/new-batch invalidation, readonly title button and private getter canaries.
